entities.summary: Joseph Francis Maguire (September 4, 1919 – November 23, 2014) was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Springfield in Massachusetts from 1977 to 1991. He previously serve as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Boston in Massachusetts from 1972 to 1977 and as coadjutor bishop of Springfield from 1976 to 1977.
